points.title: Build system and reproducibility

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: CMake/main.cpp support solve --case/--output and restart; clean build succeeds, but production executable attribution remains unbound.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Solver, mesh, physics and MPI reside primarily in one main.cpp; report generator is separate.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No direct internal solver wrapper identified; external similarity investigation excluded by trust policy.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Case JSON and CGNS paths drive general mesh/physics; no two-filename-only branch identified.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: main.cpp:1349–1366 root reads global mesh, partitions and sends local owned/ghost meshes. Root retains global mesh but other ranks do not; nonstationary rank comparisons limit numerical assurance.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Density/pressure clamps and mesh checks exist, but steady terminal load-span criterion main.cpp:1784–1794 permits very large excursions and reports failed cases converged.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Clean source build succeeds; CTest has no registered tests. Historical examiner passed output structure, not numerical convergence.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Single large main.cpp; report/run/figure manifests are delivered but raw data not committed to curated snapshot.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Perfect-gas compressible conservative NS and normalization described in report.tex and main.cpp.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CGNS unstructured zones, geometric cell/face adjacency and boundary families; METIS on root. No independent geometry oracle.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Face residual and global norms implemented; Re20 and M015 inviscid remain nonstationary while metadata calls them converged.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Rusanov local Lax–Friedrichs implemented; diffusive relative to sharper fluxes.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Farfield, slip/no-slip and adiabatic wall paths exist; surface rows describe boundary values.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: main.cpp:706–757 least-squares limited face states, called within inner iterations; historical executable not independently bound.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Barth-type limiter and density/pressure face fallback in source; no independent formal-order diagnostic.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: main.cpp:819–831 and :906–913 integrate full viscous traction despite report.tex:16 claim of tangential force; surface Cf :983–989 projects separately. Normal contribution unquantified.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: Implicit local relaxation implemented, but steady terminal plateau allows very large force excursions and mislabels Re20/M015 results.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: Full BDF residual is recomputed on accepted output state at :1624–45, but convergence ratio/counter use pre-update candidate. Metadata reports1000 misses/30000 and 0.96667 fraction; actual accepted-state ratio not independently established.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS root partition, local meshes, neighbour halo/reductions. np4/8 M015 endpoints differ0.3305 while both histories oscillate strongly; rank-only causation unproven.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Eight original workspace packages and report pass historical official structural validator; source/figure manifests named by report, but curated tip excludes raw packages.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Historical evaluator reports all eight and report pass official structural check; independent clean build passes, no CTests. Structural pass cannot validate plateau.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Re20 Cd11.320→19.550 in final3000 and M015 inv Cd spans−0.688..0.794 final2000 despite converged metadata (DQ7); two laminar drifts also material.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: M080/M200 inviscid Cd are plausible scale; Re20 Cd19.55 and M015 oscillations are not credible steady, two laminar cases drift; Re200 mean Cd0.9717/St0.1772 supported by history.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Plots are delivered, but force axes lack numeric ticks/legend, IDW fields omit body outline/spatial tick labels and Re200 late drag is flattened by startup.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report gives numeric force table and explicit IDW method, but claims tangential integrated force while code uses full traction; figure readability and false steady statuses limit reliability.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Original run and figure manifests delivered; selected M080 Mach image pixel-identically reproduces from named VTK. Other image and original executable bindings not exhaustive.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Clean immutable7f22dbe build passes in restricted cfd-bench with bundled dependencies, no CTests. Case/output/restart CLI exists; original output packages structurally validated.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: main.cpp:295–446 CGNS unstructured zones, boundary tags, cell/face geometry; root METIS graph partition :449–485. No independent geometry oracle.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: main.cpp:706 onward least-squares, Rusanov, conservative residual and wall/farfield boundary paths; substantial steady numerical failure remains result evidence.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: main.cpp:706–757 builds limited gradients and face states; source enables them in inner iterations. Formal order diagnostics and exact historical binary are unbound.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: main.cpp:819–831 and :906–913 integrate full viscous traction, though report.tex:16 calls it tangential; surface Cf :983–989 is separately projected. Normal contribution unquantified.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: BDF1/BDF2 full residual and local implicit iteration present. Accepted-state residual history is recomputed at :1624–45, but stop ratio/miss counter use pre-update ratio :1524–27,1598–1618; accepted-state target is not independently checked.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: Root holds global mesh, METIS partitions and distributes local owned/ghost meshes; halo and reductions present. M015 np4/8 terminal force discrepancy occurs on strongly oscillatory histories, and reported rank runs do not establish clean converged consistency.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Re20 and M015 inviscid strongly nonstationary yet marked converged (DQ7); two laminar cases drift substantially. Re200 t300 is periodic with credible St but 1000 misses reported and pre-update target qualification.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Report includes actual numeric summaries/plots, but force plots lack numeric ticks/legend, IDW fields omit body outlines/spatial ticks, late Re200 drag is unreadable, and tangential integrated-force claim conflicts with code.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: JSON inputs/BC tags are general, but solver is monolithic main.cpp and 3D/additional model interfaces are limited.
